hard_constraints.items: actual owned NH starter items only
hard_constraints.target: same valid target identity/generation and current tick
hard_constraints.attacks: recheck cooldown, range, spell level, target health and execution confirmation
hard_constraints.supplies: available stock and native food/potion locks
hard_constraints.prayers: required level and positive points; allow explicit OFF
hard_constraints.special: AGS owned, shield stow space, at least 50 energy; enable idempotently
hard_constraints.movement: freeze/collision gates; one explicit movement budget per tick
hard_constraints.joint_actions: validate after movement and resource use; factorized masks do not prove full-vector legality

counters.protect_from_magic: ranged; melee when reachable and advantageous
counters.protect_from_melee: magic or ranged by expected damage and switch cost

limitations.prayer_model: OSRS average drain; NH/Orion discrete-tick calibration unverified
limitations.runes: pinned simulator does not model rune-pouch charge depletion
limitations.incoming_threat: visible weapon estimates; no future rolled-hit information
limitations.transfer: simulator only; no automatic Orion activation
